note: HAND-AUTHORED. This is the one part of the registry that is NOT generated, and the one part
a regeneration must never touch. _registry.py merges it in; it never writes here.
GHOST VALUES are the standard example values a function is demonstrated with. They cannot be
derived from a contract -- a contract states that a parameter is a `decimal`, not that 1.0 is
a sensible one to show. They exist so that every consumer demonstrates a function the SAME
way, and so a tooltip or a ZBOM can render a real preview before a user has typed anything.
THE SAME SET FEEDS BOTH the execution shape and the INFO preview. That is the point: if the
preview renders a sensible sentence from these values, the wiring resolved -- names, arity,
types and the contract's own reading of the operation. A correct preview is evidence of
correct wiring, which is what makes hovering a button a substitute for testing it.
PLACEHOLDERS IN ANGLE BRACKETS are resolved by the consumer at render time, because they
SEEDING: harvest from the ZBOM that already wires a function -- those values were chosen
deliberately. Author the rest as each button is wired, so wiring a button and giving it ghost
values are one act rather than two.
